procedure: After author inactivity, enter the delivered evaluator-shell. This does not authorize collection/scoring/provider launch.
Run verification_command; compare opaque index hash with this receipt. Never print or export the private index paths.
Inside evaluator only, resolve own /opt/evaluator/inputs/.independent-resume/<resume_id>.json and verify payload/manifest hashes,public seal,campaign and exact consumer profile.
Existing /opt/evaluator/support-v5 is read-only and importable; no custom mount needed. Use shared_campaign.prepare_adapter for generic baseline binding.
Normalize absent optional actions to empty ReleasedFixtureActions without granting capability. Candidate binding follows later independently reviewed freeze.
memory_policy: Existing host default; temporary2GB configuration was not applied and was removed. No fixed2GBcap claimed.
